promotions.behavior: Central help-reference service validates topics and aliases and provides deterministic permission-filtered resolution and search.
assumptions: This proves Reforged coordination behavior, not exact native MajorMUD HELP implementation.
promotions.safeFallback: Hide unauthorized topics and return typed not-found or invalid-query results.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Provides one validated help lookup and search boundary.

promotions.behavior: Help content ownership remains explicit across module, host, generated catalogs, and Librarium references.
assumptions: Command, ability, spell, item, and quest catalogs retain semantic ownership of generated reference content.
tests: content owner and source textblock smoke assertions
promotions.safeFallback: Do not project unowned Librarium or host content into Classic runtime.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Prevents help data from becoming an unauthorized behavior source.

promotions.behavior: Administrative help topics are permission-filtered and fail closed for normal players.
assumptions: Runtime access levels are supplied by the security owner.
promotions.safeFallback: Return topic unavailable without revealing restricted content.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Prevents administrative capability disclosure through help lookup.
